name: surprise_s3_base_manifest_404_crash_rotate_gc
covers: surprise 3, its own shape: a page crashes in the middle of a commit, a new page of the device reads the commit key and, before it reads the manifest the key names, a peer rotates that manifest out of the retained list and a collection pass deletes it together with the crashed commit's orphan; the page's manifest read finds the unit gone and the boot decides the recovery screen

labels.A: begin ordinary commit; A: upload u/A1: a1: open, commit: the first unit upload is applied and the page is gone; the orphan unit stays in the store
labels.A: read commit key -> v1 cur=m/0 stg=nul: a2: a new page once a1 is gone: open reads the fence and the commit key (current is the seeded manifest) and then reads the manifest; that read is held
labels.B: begin ordinary commit #1..#3; B: comm: b: twenty-one commits after a2's read, each after the retention admission interval; the twenty-first pushes the seeded manifest out of the retained list
labels.GC: pass; GC: remove [m/0, u/A1.0.g0]: g: a collection pass after b's last commit retires the seeded tree and the orphan; the pass releases a2's held read
labels.A: read manifest m/0 -> missing; re-read: a2: the manifest read finds nothing; open classifies the boot as the recovery screen, row 6 with the tree missing
